subsystems.name: Factory
subsystems.role: Market deployment, bootstrap seeding, collateral whitelist

subsystems.name: Outcome Tokens
subsystems.role: Per-outcome ERC20 shares, owned by market

subsystems.name: Staking Vault
subsystems.role: AFTR staking, fee distribution, epoch tracking

subsystems.name: Router
subsystems.role: Deposit/redeem proxy with DRP debt repayment

flows.name: Market Creation
flows.path: User → Factory.createPriceMarket → Deployer.deployPriceMarket → Market(new) → Market.initialize → Market.bootstrapLiquidity

flows.name: Trade
flows.path: User → Market.deposit → [0.3% → Creator] → [1.2% → Vault.receiveFees] → [98.5% → realPool] → OutcomeToken.mint

flows.name: Redemption
flows.path: Winner → Market.redeem → OutcomeToken.burnFrom → collateral sent to winner

flows.name: Staking
flows.path: User → Vault.stake → sAFTR.mint | Vault.initiateUnstake → [lockDuration] → Vault.completeUnstake → sAFTR.burn
